79: // NewListenerWrapper creates a new listenerWrapper with params. It returns a
80: // net.Listener. It starts in state not serving, which triggers Accept() +
81: // Close() on any incoming connections.
82: //
83: // Only TCP listeners are supported.
84: func NewListenerWrapper(params ListenerWrapperParams) net.Listener {
85: 	lw := &listenerWrapper{
86: 		Listener:          params.Listener,
87: 		name:              params.ListenerResourceName,
88: 		xdsC:              params.XDSClient,
89: 		xdsNodeID:         params.XDSClient.BootstrapConfig().Node().GetId(),
90: 		modeCallback:      params.ModeCallback,
91: 		isUnspecifiedAddr: params.Listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).IP.IsUnspecified(),
92: 		conns:             make(map[*connWrapper]bool),
93: 		mode:              connectivity.ServingModeNotServing,
94: 		closed:            grpcsync.NewEvent(),
95: 		httpFilters:       make(map[serverFilterKey]*refCountedServerFilter),
96: 	}
97: 	lw.logger = internalgrpclog.NewPrefixLogger(logger, fmt.Sprintf("[xds-server-listener %p] ", lw))
98: 
99: 	// Serve() verifies that Addr() returns a valid TCPAddr. So, it is safe to
100: 	// ignore the error from SplitHostPort().
101: 	lisAddr := lw.Listener.Addr().String()
102: 	lw.addr, lw.port, _ = net.SplitHostPort(lisAddr)
103: 
104: 	lw.rdsHandler = newRDSHandler(lw.handleRDSUpdate, lw.xdsC, lw.logger)
105: 	lw.cancelWatch = xdsresource.WatchListener(lw.xdsC, lw.name, &ldsWatcher{
106: 		parent: lw,
107: 		logger: lw.logger,
108: 		name:   lw.name,
109: 	})
110: 	return lw
111: }
